flags.text: INPE PRODES maps 148 ha of deforestation inside this ranch after the EUDR cut-off (31 Dec 2020). Cattle raised here cannot enter the EU and large clearings are rarely licensed.
flags.title: 148 ha cleared after 2020

flags.text: Embargoed on 2024-08-03 after illegal clearing was detected. Any GTA from this ranch is refused by the ledger.
flags.title: Under environmental embargo
